_comment: EXAMPLE prod parameters for main.bicep. Copy to infra/main.prod.parameters.json (the name scripts/deploy.sh and scripts/set-secrets.sh read) and replace every <...> value with your own. No SQL password lives here: the SQL server is Entra-only and the web + Functions apps authenticate with their managed identities.
_comment_baseName: Use the SAME baseName as dev so the two environments read rg-<baseName>-dev / rg-<baseName>-prod. Lowercase letters and digits only, at most 12 characters.
_comment_customDomain: Informational: the hostname you will bind AFTER the deploy, once its DNS CNAME exists (see README 'Getting started').
_comment_backstageEmbedOrigin: The origin allowed to embed the hub in an iframe (e.g. https://your-event-portal.example). Empty = the hub cannot be framed.
_comment_sqlAadAdmin: An Entra (Azure AD) GROUP that administers the SQL server. Put its display name and object id here.
